moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The late August Bank Holiday weekend officially begins, offering a final chance for many across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland to enjoy the summer before autumn.

angles.name: Travel Alert
angles.copy: Packing for the Bank Holiday getaway? Get set for a busy one on the roads and rails across England, Wales & Northern Ireland as the long weekend kicks off. Plan ahead!

angles.name: Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: Last long weekend of the summer for many! How are you making the most of the August Bank Holiday? Beach, BBQ or just chilling? Let us know!

moments.title: UK Festival Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Major UK festivals including Creamfields, Leeds Festival, and Reading Festival all kick off this weekend, bringing huge acts and thousands of music fans together.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: It's THE weekend! Creamfields, Leeds, Reading – where are you pitching your tent (or just dancing in a field)? The UK festival season is going out with a bang!

angles.name: Leeds & Reading
angles.copy: Reading and Leeds Festivals are about to explode! Who are you most hyped to see on the main stages this weekend? Let the festival anthems begin!

moments.title: Victorious Festival Returns to Portsmouth
moments.blurb: Victorious Festival, the UK's most beautifully located festival, begins this Friday in Portsmouth, promising a bank holiday seaside celebration with a diverse lineup.

angles.name: Portsmouth Party
angles.copy: Portsmouth! Victorious Festival is almost here, bringing huge acts and that incredible seaside vibe. Who's ready for a bank holiday weekend by the beach, soundtracked by the best music?

angles.name: Family Festival
angles.copy: Looking for the ultimate family-friendly festival experience this Bank Holiday? Victorious Festival in Portsmouth has something for everyone! Music, sun, sea... what more could you want?

moments.title: Between The Trees Festival in Bridgend
moments.blurb: Between The Trees Festival kicks off this Thursday in Bridgend, offering a unique blend of music, art, and nature in a beautiful Welsh setting.

angles.name: Welsh Festival Fun
angles.copy: Bridgend is buzzing! Between The Trees Festival starts this Thursday, bringing an amazing atmosphere and incredible music to South Wales. Who's heading along?

angles.name: Bridgend Beats
angles.copy: Get ready, Bridgend! Your very own Between The Trees Festival is almost here. Expect good vibes, great music and a fantastic start to the Bank Holiday weekend!

moments.title: The Good Ship Murder S3 on BritBox
moments.blurb: The third season of 'The Good Ship Murder' premieres today for regular BritBox subscribers, with Shayne Ward returning as the cabaret singer detective.

angles.name: New Mystery Today
angles.copy: All aboard for murder! The Good Ship Murder Season 3 sets sail today for regular BritBox subscribers. Get ready for more sun-drenched mysteries with Shayne Ward!

angles.name: Shayne Ward Returns
angles.copy: Shayne Ward is back as the singing detective! The Good Ship Murder Season 3 hits BritBox today. Perfect viewing for a Tuesday night, if you ask us.

moments.title: Billy Ray Cyrus is 65 Today
moments.blurb: Country music icon Billy Ray Cyrus, known for 'Achy Breaky Heart' and 'Old Town Road', celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Country Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to the one and only Billy Ray Cyrus! Still 'Achy Breaky' after all these years? We're playing his biggest hits right now!

moments.title: Gene Simmons Turns 77
moments.blurb: KISS co-founder and bassist Gene Simmons, the 'Demon' himself, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to KISS legend Gene Simmons! Still rocking and rolling all night (and partying every day). What's your favourite KISS track?

moments.title: Rob Halford is 75 Today
moments.blurb: Judas Priest frontman and 'Metal God' Rob Halford celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Metal God's Birthday
angles.copy: Raise your horns! Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Rob Halford of Judas Priest. The 'Metal God' is still going strong!

moments.title: Elvis Costello Turns 72
moments.blurb: Influential singer-songwriter Elvis Costello, known for hits like 'Oliver's Army' and 'Alison', celebrates his 72nd birthday today.

angles.name: New Wave Legend
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the brilliant Elvis Costello! Still delivering those sharp lyrics and unforgettable melodies. What's your favourite of his tracks?

moments.title: Shirley Manson is 60 Tomorrow
moments.blurb: Garbage frontwoman Shirley Manson, known for her distinctive vocals and fierce stage presence, celebrates her 60th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Garbage Queen
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the incredible Shirley Manson of Garbage turns 60! Get ready to celebrate a true rock icon. What's your favourite Garbage track?

moments.title: Alex Lifeson Turns 73
moments.blurb: Rush guitarist Alex Lifeson, a progressive rock legend, celebrates his 73rd birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Prog Rock Royalty
angles.copy: On Wednesday, we're celebrating the 73rd birthday of Rush's phenomenal guitarist, Alex Lifeson! What's your favourite Rush epic?

moments.title: Glen Matlock is 70
moments.blurb: Glen Matlock, original bassist for the Sex Pistols and co-writer of many of their early hits, celebrates his 70th birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Punk Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 70th Birthday to punk rock legend Glen Matlock, original bassist for the Sex Pistols! A true innovator in music history.

moments.title: Shania Twain Turns 61
moments.blurb: Country-pop superstar Shania Twain, known for anthems like 'Man! I Feel Like a Woman!', celebrates her 61st birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop
angles.copy: Let's go girls! Shania Twain turns 61 on Thursday! Get ready to celebrate the Queen of Country Pop with her greatest hits.

moments.title: Florence Welch is 40
moments.blurb: Florence + The Machine's enchanting frontwoman, Florence Welch, celebrates her 40th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Happy 40th Florence
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the mesmerising Florence Welch! We're celebrating the incredible voice and artistry of Florence + The Machine all day Thursday.

moments.title: Jack Black Turns 57
moments.blurb: Actor, comedian, and Tenacious D frontman Jack Black celebrates his 57th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Rock & Comedy King
angles.copy: It's Jack Black's 57th Birthday on Thursday! From Tenacious D to Hollywood blockbusters, he truly is a legend. What's your favourite Jack Black moment?

moments.title: Paul Oakenfold is 63
moments.blurb: Legendary DJ and trance producer Paul Oakenfold, a pioneer of electronic music, celebrates his 63rd birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Trance Titan
angles.copy: Get ready to drop the beat! On Saturday, the iconic DJ Paul Oakenfold turns 63. We're spinning some of his biggest tracks to celebrate!

moments.title: Van Morrison Turns 81
moments.blurb: Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison, famous for 'Brown Eyed Girl' and 'Moondance', celebrates his 81st birthday on Bank Holiday Monday.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Blues & Soul
angles.copy: On Bank Holiday Monday, the legendary Van Morrison turns 81! Get ready for a day of 'Brown Eyed Girl' and 'Moondance' as we celebrate the Belfast Cowboy.

moments.title: Debbie Gibson is 56
moments.blurb: Pop sensation Debbie Gibson, who rose to fame as a teen idol in the late 80s, celebrates her 56th birthday on Bank Holiday Monday.

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Remember 'Foolish Beat'? It's Debbie Gibson's 56th Birthday on Bank Holiday Monday! We're throwing back to the 80s for the ultimate pop princess.
